text:
Ana (Finance): Quick heads-up: we're introducing a short 'burst grace' behavior and a clearer invoice line for any buffered overage. Aim is to reduce noisy alerts for short spikes while keeping billing transparent. Rollout next Tue.

Jordan (Product): Quick Q: will SDKs still surface 429s the same way?

Ana (Finance): Short answer: fewer immediate 429s for very short spikes (<=30s). Long or sustained bursts will still be rate-limited as today. We'll also add a `grace_used_tokens` field on invoices so customers can see how much buffer was applied.

Emma (Support): Can I get customer-facing copy? Need to prep KB and support playbook.

Ana (Finance): Draft blurb: "We now allow brief bursts without immediate throttling; persistent high traffic will still be subject to standard rate limits. See the invoice breakdown for details (new field: grace_used_tokens)." Longer FAQ will cover edge cases and opt-out steps.

Khalid (Eng): Implementation notes: runtime will maintain a per-key sliding counter and suppress hard throttles for bursts under 30s. New telemetry: `soft_throttle_suppressed` (count) and `soft_grace_consumed_tokens`. We'll surface these in Console and the metrics API.

sre-bot: Deploy plan: canary at 10% traffic Tue 03:00 UTC; full rollout by Thu 18:00 UTC if error rate/latency look fine. Auto-rollback if error rate +0.5% or p50 latency +25ms.

Jordan (Product): Does this apply to Dedicated and Private?

Ana (Finance): Dedicated: same behavior unless customer opts out. Private/on-prem: we won't force the change; we'll provide config toggles in the next on-prem patch.

billing-bot: Example invoice snippet (appears under "Usage adjustments"):

```
Usage adjustments:
  base_tokens: 12,435,212
  overage_tokens: 1,210
  grace_used_tokens: 320
  billed_overage_tokens: 890
```

Khalid (Eng): Note: `grace_used_tokens` is visible but only reduces billed overage if the total overage is greater than the grace. Computation: `billed_overage_tokens = max(0, overage_tokens - grace_used_tokens)`.

Emma (Support): I'll have KB + playbook draft by Mon EOD. Requesting final FAQ copy by Mon 12:00 PT so we can align responses.

Ana (Finance): Action items: Jordan approve public copy by Mon 12:00 PT; Khalid add dashboards/metrics API by canary; Emma draft KB & playbook. Ping me with blockers. :thumbsup: 

Jordan (Product): I'll review copy now. :ok_hand:

Khalid (Eng): Working on dashboards, will post links.

billing-bot: Heads-up: invoice schema change ships in Billing API v1.3; clients with strict schema validation should patch.

Emma (Support): Leaving thread open for updates.

Ana (Finance): Thanks all — aiming for low customer disruption and clearer invoicing.
